headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 11, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of shutout pitching. Caleb Durbin led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Detroit Tigers shortstop Javier Báez has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right ankle sprain. Los Angeles Dodgers catcher Will Smith has been placed on the 10-day injured list with neck inflammation, while Texas Rangers left-hander Jalen Beeks is out with low back spasms. Pittsburgh Pirates center fielder Oneil Cruz is on the 10-day injured list with non-displaced fractures in his left hand.

The Philadelphia Phillies acquired right fielder Derek Hill and other considerations from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for center fielder Dylan Campbell and second baseman Jose Colmenares. The Detroit Tigers received right-hander Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers in a trade. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded right-hander Carson Fulmer to the Seattle Mariners for cash, while the Tampa Bay Rays sent second baseman Raynel Delgado to the Houston Astros for cash.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Red Sox 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of shutout pitching. Caleb Durbin led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians 8-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured an 8-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Carlos Rodón earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts. Angel Martínez led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Giants Come from Behind in Thrilling 11-10 Win**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants overcame a 10-7 deficit to defeat the Washington Nationals 11-10. Bryce Eldridge hit a game-changing grand slam in the 8th inning, scoring three runs and securing the win for the Giants.

top_news.title: **Padres Edge Reds in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 5-4 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Fernando Tatis Jr. leading the charge at the plate. Tatis Jr. hit two home runs, including a key line drive to left field, and drove in two runs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall Short in Mets Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged the St. Louis Cardinals 5-4 in a closely contested game. Christian Scott was a standout on the mound for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Twins 11-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a convincing 11-0 victory. Impact hitters for the Tigers included Royce Lewis, Riley Greene, and Spencer Torkelson, while Wenceel Pérez also contributed to the team's strong performance.

top_news.title: **Javier Báez Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers shortstop Javier Báez has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right ankle sprain.

top_news.title: **Phillies Acquire Outfielder in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies made a move on June 11, 2026, acquiring a player from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for outfielder Dylan Campbell and second baseman Jose Colmenares.
